title: Sprint 9C supplemental source candidates, independently researched
verificationScope: Pages opened via public web, source text/paraphrase checked; no rechecked printed edition; GitHub branch may change after this pack. Do not promote source verification on pack alone.

records.checkedObservation: Page describes Phá Quân alone at Tý or Ngọ, opposite Liêm Trinh–Thiên Tướng; stronger variant depends on year, transformations and absence of sát/kỵ/Không Kiếp.
records.nextAction: Compare core structural rule to B3 Phá Quân Tý/Ngọ; classify extra conditions rather than forcing them all to be mandatory.

records.checkedObservation: Article gives alternative configurations: Thái Dương at Hợi/Tý/Sửu or Thái Âm at Tỵ/Ngọ/Mùi; mentions Cự Môn involvement. Not simply both Sun and Moon hãm anywhere.
records.nextAction: Potential FORMULA_CONFLICT: B3 uses both Thái Dương and Thái Âm in hãm status. Verify source identity and if author cites real historical text.

records.checkedObservation: The page is actually 命裡逢空格; it mentions 半天折翅 in a separate classical-style line. The catalog says Chiết Xỉ, not Chiết Sí.
records.nextAction: Do NOT accept identity as proven; check Vietnamese transcription/Xỉ vs Sí, and whether B3 formula about Không Kiếp meeting authority stars is supported.

records.checkedObservation: Wikisource 全書 卷一 太微賦 has 帝遇兇徒 as part of a couplet. A symbolic clause, not a complete explicit star list.
records.nextAction: Prompt the two models to avoid inferring Kình/Hỏa thresholds from the phrase; may be incomplete/not executable.

records.checkedObservation: Wikisource 全書 卷一 太微賦 associates the phrase 路上埋屍 with Liêm Trinh and Thất Sát sharing a palace. Its Chinese characters are 路上, not 路傍.
records.nextAction: Separate verified phrase from catalog alias; B3 adds Sửu/Mùi and Hóa Kỵ/Kình Đà, which this short clause does not establish.

records.checkedObservation: Wikisource 全書 卷一 太微賦 pairs 吉處藏凶 with 祿逢沖破.
records.nextAction: Potential FORMULA_CONFLICT: B3 requires Địa Kiếp/Triệt. Do not infer those from 祿逢沖破.

records.checkedObservation: Wikisource 全書 卷一 太微賦 mentions 文耗居寅卯.
records.nextAction: Potential FORMULA_CONFLICT: B3 uses Đại Hao + Tiểu Hao in Mão/Dậu. Distinguish 文耗, exact star and palace positions before asserting equivalence.

records.checkedObservation: Wikisource 全書 卷一 太微賦 describes Thái Âm at Tý (太陰居子).
records.nextAction: Potential FORMULA_CONFLICT: B3 requires Thiên Đồng and Thái Âm same at Tý; passage only explicitly states Thái Âm at Tý.

records.checkedObservation: Vietnamese modern article describes Tử Vi, Thiên Phủ, Vũ Khúc, Thiên Tướng in tam phương/tứ chính. A separate Tuvica source claims book Áo Bí page 341, unverified by this research.
records.nextAction: Validate structural claims against deterministic star placement; beware varying versions requiring Tử Phủ cùng cung vs broad tetrad in tam phương.

records.checkedObservation: Modern article directly defines Thất Sát, Phá Quân, Tham Lang in the Mệnh–Tài–Quan triangle; distinguishes structural constellation from auspicious/broken formation.
records.nextAction: Check whether this is near-automatic structural invariant under certain placements; do not count it as a rare special good fortune on merely seeing three stars.

records.checkedObservation: The article discusses Vũ Khúc and Thiên Tướng at Dần/Thân and describes 財印 in semantic terms; it does not verify an historical formal combination called Tài Ấn Giao Trì.
records.nextAction: Retain unverified name. Seek print source with formal exact name, or classify as a derived star pair not a named source-verified cách cục.

records.checkedObservation: Wikisource question on Văn Khúc discusses Văn Khúc meeting Cự Môn; does not clearly identify the Vietnamese formal name Khúc Ám Đồng Cung. Secondary Chinese pages likewise mention the pair.
records.nextAction: Maintain RELATED_CONCEPT; verify whether Ám refers to Cự Môn, and whether đồng cung vs hội chiếu are separately supported.

records.nextAction: Keep SOURCE_NOT_LOCATED; do not infer hãm+sat from generic Thiên Cơ interpretations. Try authenticated source indexes or page-specific book references.

records.checkedObservation: Article includes a Hán văn section 巨逢四煞格 with combinations involving Cự Môn and four sát stars; a Vietnamese modern site uses three families including Không/Kiếp. The definitions differ.
records.nextAction: Mark CONFLICTING_SOURCE_DEFINITIONS. B3 currently demands all Kình, Đà, Hỏa, Linh; do not simply choose one by model consensus.

records.nextAction: Critical catalog issue: B3 required_stars is Hóa Kỵ despite name/formula referring to Hoa Cái. Research identity and create remediation finding, not runtime edit.

records.searchAnchor: 兩重天馬 / 雙馬 / 流天馬

records.nextAction: Keep source inaccessible for exact rule and runtime disabled. Do not invent the moving-star calculation or dates.

records.checkedObservation: Detailed 2013 article says Thiên Đồng alone at Tỵ/Hợi and Thiên Lương in đối cung, not same-palace.
records.nextAction: Potential FORMULA_CONFLICT: B3 allows đồng cung OR opposition at Tỵ/Hợi and marks both hãm. Verify placement against engine; do not equate same-palace with this source.

records.checkedObservation: Page explicitly titles 日月疾厄格 and discusses Thái Dương/Thái Âm at Tật Ách, with extra conditions like Kỵ/sát.
records.nextAction: Possible source-backed concept but not historical print authentication. Flag health predictions as cultural interpretation, not medical facts.
